name: vLLM#52627: Kimi-K3 silent corruption with Mooncake+NIXL MultiConnector
notes: Kimi-K3 TP=8 1P1D deployment with MooncakeStoreConnector+NixlConnector shows intermittent silent output corruption. NIXL-only is stable. Corruption appears with Mooncake enabled, even without speculative decoding. Suspected: hybrid cache interaction between Kimi-K3, MooncakeStoreConnector, MultiConnector, and KDA recurrent state. Demonstrates KV cache corruption with external cache.
